target_definition: Citi Bike JC monthly-file service scope; trip starts per UTC hour, with target-hour calendar interpreted in America/New_York
ambiguous_dst_policy: Drop trips with ambiguous naive local timestamps; set both UTC fall-back target hours to NaN and exclude from scoring
conflicting_duplicate_policy: Exclude all ride IDs with conflicting started_at; keep first occurrence of other duplicates in sorted official archive and member order
zero_demand_policy: Zero only after all 24 monthly source archives are present and ZIP-valid; possible reporting outages remain a limitation
evaluation: One-step-ahead rolling forecast; 2024 used for model selection, 2025 used once for final holdout confirmation. Earlier exploratory code viewed 2025 metrics; this is not a pristine blind test.
